pages.text: The AMR is a hollow 7x7x7 cube.$(br2)Each face is a rounded shape: the corners may stay empty, the outer rim must be $(item)AMR Casing$(), and the inner area can be Casing or $(item)AMR Ports$().
The inside must be empty, except for Mekanism $(item)Supercharged Coils$().$(br2)Every coil must sit directly behind a Port. A coil with no Port behind it stops the structure from forming.
